## Parser

Build and run the parser with:

```sh
cmake --build build
bin/debug/flux-parser testfile/test.fl
```

Pass an optional second argument to save the printed AST to a file:

```sh
bin/debug/flux-parser testfile/test.fl log/ast/test.fl.ast
```

The Linux test runner saves each test's AST under `log/ast/`.

The parser prints the AST and supports formatted strings, arrays, `typedef`
structure declarations, and typed or anonymous structure initialization, in
addition to the control-flow and expression syntax shown in the sample.
Run the sample test with `ctest --test-dir build`.
